description: List draft time entries awaiting the signed-in user's approval, including internal work and accessible client matters. Owners/admins also see drafts without an assigned approver. Optionally filter work dates (from/to, YYYY-MM-DD), timekeeper (member), and matter. Returns logged durationMinutes separately from adjusted billedMinutes and the last return comment. Follow nextCursor for the next bounded page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page
